id: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
en: \bI'm the Pokémon Move Maniac.
it: \bSono il Maniaco delle Mosse Pokémon.

id: \bI know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up.
en: \bI know every single move that Pokémon learn growing up.
it: \bConosco ogni singola mossa che i Pokémon imparano crescendo.

id: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
en: \bI'm also a collector of Heart Scales.
it: \bColleziono anche Squame Cuore.

id: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
en: \bIf you bring me one, I'll teach a move to one of your Pokémon.
it: \bSe me ne porti una, insegnerò una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
en: \bOh! That's it! That's an honest to goodness Heart Scale!
it: \bOh! Eccola! È una Squama Cuore autentica al cento per cento!

id: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
en: \bLet me guess, you want me to teach one of your Pokémon a move?
it: \bFammi indovinare, vuoi che insegni una mossa a uno dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
en: \bWhich Pokémon needs tutoring?
it: \bQuale Pokémon ha bisogno di lezioni?

id: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
en: \bIf your Pokémon need to learn a move, come back with a Heart Scale.
it: \bSe i tuoi Pokémon devono imparare una mossa, torna con una Squama Cuore.

id: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an Egg.
en: \bHunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an Egg.
it: \bEh? Non c'è nemmeno una mossa che possa insegnare a un Uovo.

id: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
en: \bNo way, I don't want to go near a Shadow Pokémon..
it: \bNeanche per sogno, non voglio avvicinarmi a un Pokémon Ombra...

id: \bSorry...
en: \bSorry...
it: \bMi dispiace...

id: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
en: \bIt doesn't appear as if I have any move I can teach to your \v[3].
it: \bA quanto pare non ho nessuna mossa da insegnare al tuo \v[3].

id: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
en: \bWhich move should I teach to your \v[3]?
it: \bQuale mossa devo insegnare al tuo \v[3]?

id: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
en: \PN handed over one Heart Scale in exchange.
it: \PN ha consegnato una Squama Cuore in cambio.

id: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
en: \rHello, and welcome to the Pokémon Center.
it: \rCiao, benvenuto al Centro Pokémon.

id: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe restore your tired Pokémon to full health.
it: \rQui rimettiamo in forze i tuoi Pokémon stanchi.

id: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
en: \rWould you like to rest your Pokémon?
it: \rVuoi far riposare i tuoi Pokémon?

id: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
en: \rOK, I'll take your Pokémon for a few seconds.
it: \rBene, prendo i tuoi Pokémon per qualche secondo.

id: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
en: \rYour Pokémon may be infected by PokeRus.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon potrebbero aver contratto il Pokérus.

id: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
en: \rLittle is known about the PokeRus except that they are microscopic life-forms that attach to Pokémon.
it: \rSi sa poco del Pokérus, se non che si tratta di forme di vita microscopiche che si attaccano ai Pokémon.

id: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
en: \rWhile infected, Pokémon are said to grow exceptionally well.
it: \rSi dice che i Pokémon infetti crescano eccezionalmente bene.

id: \rThank you for waiting.
en: \rThank you for waiting.
it: \rGrazie per l'attesa.

id: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rWe've restored your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono di nuovo in piena forma.

id: \rWe hope to see you again!
en: \rWe hope to see you again!
it: \rTorna a trovarci!

id: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
en: \rFirst, you should restore your Pokémon to full health.
it: \rPer prima cosa, dovresti rimettere in forze i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
en: \rYour Pokémon have been healed to perfect health.
it: \rI tuoi Pokémon sono stati curati e sono in perfetta salute.

id: \rWe hope you excel!
en: \rWe hope you excel!
it: \rSpero che tu abbia successo!
